# optimizelycmssaas_content_source (Data Source)

Looks up an existing content_source by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmssaas_content_source" "item" {
  key = "Item"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the content_source to look up.

### Read-Only

- `base_type` (String) Base type of the corresponding content type, e.g. _page.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the CMS for this source.
- `property_mappings` (Attributes) How source items map to CMS items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--property_mappings))
- `source_key` (String) Key of the source this content source relates to.
- `source_type` (String) Source type within the source.
- `type` (String) Source kind, e.g. graph.

<a id="nestedatt--property_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `property_mappings`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Item display name in the CMS.
- `key` (String) Item key in the source. Required unless source_type is _Item. Cannot be changed.
- `key_format` (String) Format of the source identifier, e.g. digits, digitsWithHyphens.
